reviews.text: Amazing they saved my 15 year old puppy Mia. The doctor was amazing and so was everybody else who helped.
Excellent service, very clean. I loved the way they treated me and my dog. I recommend them to everyone. 👌 …
Absolutely love the place the staff  the doctor thank you very much for taking care of my dog

I love this clinic. The staff is incredibly friendly, speaks both Spanish and English, and communicates perfectly. I've been twice now, first with my dog ​​Balto and then with my cat Salem, and both times they've treated me wonderfully. They explain all the procedures, and nothing is mandatory. If you don't want to do something, you can postpone it or choose to skip it. They accept financing through CareCredit and have many options if you want to insure your pets medically. It's an excellent place; I highly recommend it.

I had such a wonderful experience bringing my cat here! 🐱❤️ From the moment we arrived, everyone was incredibly kind, welcoming, and professional. They treated my little one with so much care and patience, and made me feel comfortable throughout the entire visit.

You can truly tell that the whole team loves animals and cares about their patients. I’m so happy with the service we received and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I’m thrilled to share that after 8 years of many try’s and fails, I finally found the Vet team with the right experience and gentle bedside manner to set my dog at ease enough to bypass the need of a muzzle. It has literally changed Mandy’s life!
Dr. Diaz and her team were nothing short of miraculous. Their thoroughness and.compassion didn’t stop with my dog. They really took the time to explain things to me and give me options that I can work with.
Needless to say, we will be back, since we’ve found the Vet that we’d always hoped for at Miami Welfare Animal Clinic!
Excellent service for my dog.

I called to ask about a price estimate for an abdominal xray for a cat with possible kidney stones (3 pictures: both sides, & belly) & the receptionist said that a consultation is necessary and that they don’t do price estimates. I find that shady since all the other clinics I called gave me a ballpark number ! Other reviewers said they are transparent but this interaction did not seem that way

My experience at this clinic was fantastic! 👍 Excellent, I highly recommend it. They were very patient with us and our dog, they treated us wonderfully, explained everything in detail, and the hygiene was superb—everything was spotless. I can only thank them for providing such excellent service. 👌 …
Dr. Ramirez and her staff were amazing.  Very thorough and made sure our fur baby got everything she needed.    Thank you.

Thank you for the 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and for choosing Miami Welfare Animal Clinic for your pet’s veterinary care. Our team is committed to providing compassionate, professional care for every pet that walks through our doors. We look forward to seeing you and your furry family member again!
GREAT SERVICE THANK YOU!!!!

Excellent service to both my dog ​​and me; clean, hygienic, and friendly.
Vet Mariangel and her technician were very professional and patient with Mookie. 1000% recommended.
First check up of my puppy, very professional. They explained all procedures and recommended me on the next steps with the dog, very thankful!!
The best clinic in Miami. I brought my dog ​​in for vaccinations, and the service was excellent.

I would not recommend this place. My experience left me feeling like the priority was money rather than the well-being of the animals or the people bringing them in. The customer service was cold, dismissive, and completely lacking in empathy. When you’re dealing with someone’s pet, especially when they’re worried or stressed, compassion should be the bare minimum.

Everything felt transactional, rushed, and focused on charges instead of actually making you feel heard or cared for. I left feeling frustrated, disappointed, and honestly shocked by how little concern was shown. There are plenty of veterinary offices that understand both medicine and basic human kindness. I would spend my money somewhere that treats people and their animals with more respect.

I want to sincerely thank Drs. Mariangel and Adriana, as well as the wonderful staff, Angela, Laura, and Rosie, for the love, care, and professionalism they showed Priska throughout her dental procedure and extractions. ❤️🐾

From the very beginning, they made me feel at ease, and most importantly, I knew Priska was in excellent hands. They treated her with so much love and attention, and her recovery has been absolutely wonderful, especially considering that she is 11 years old. 🥹💕

I’m truly grateful for the exceptional care they provided and for the peace of mind they gave me throughout the entire process. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of my girl! 🐶❤️

If I can give -0 stars I would! Do Not bring your pets here. So I brought my cat here for an ultrasound and on the paper that states if anything happens to your animal because of anesthesia I simply put if medication is needed to please consult with me. So the Owner/vet of this clinic kicked me out. She said that because I wrote that on the paper she will not see my cat but mind you if she would have read it instead of acting impulsively then she would have known it didn’t say anything wrong. Even when the front desk girl brought me the paper back and said the doctor wouldn’t initial I said okay and didn’t give any type of push back. The doctor which I’ve met before is very condescending also. I wouldn’t trust this practice, I work for a big business and if you’re doing your job, have all your licenses up to date, and are doing the right thing you wouldn't be scared about initialing a paper and kick someone out of your business.  If anything this business should be looked into and I’ll be making a complaint to the BBB. I’ve uploaded the paper as proof.

Update and response : At no point was there any sort of disrespect to any one in this facility. Pets are like our kids and the document they provided is not clear about reaching out if the medication is needed. I want to look out for my furr baby as any other person. The signature about you contacting me isn’t something out of the usual .Again,I heard the doctors TONE when the front desk asked for it and it automatically made her upset. She has no emotional intelligence and anyone who meets her can confirm that. I didn’t even speak about another occasion when I showed up on a Sunday and they had an unlicensed vet on site which caused me to leave. How did I know he was not licensed? He didn’t speak one word of English which would be impossible to pass any state board exam. Everything happens for a reason and I’m glad this happened because everything I thought about this clinic confirmed it yesterday. And in no way shape or form can this clinic be trusted.
Love this place. Dr. Diaz is phenomenal and very accommodating. I take all.my cats & rescues there.
Emergency with toe nail on my dog.  They did excellent job in removing it.  Very professional.   Will definetly go back.

I don't usually write reviews, but this medical team deserves all my praise and eternal gratitude for saving my pet's life; they are very professional and treat everyone with incredible care and patience. The doctor who operated on my dog, Melchor, did an excellent job. I highly recommend them.

Thank you so much for the 5-star review!  We truly appreciate your support. It means so much to our entire team to know you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to caring for you and your pets again!
Very knowledgeable and attentive staff
Excellent clinic, very clean and organized, Drs and personnel are very friendly, Thank you

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and trust in Miami Welfare Animal Clinic. Our team is dedicated to providing compassionate, quality care for every pet and their family. We’re grateful for the opportunity to be part of your pet’s healthcare journey and look forward to seeing you again!

I can’t thank the team enough for the amazing care they gave Grace. From the moment we arrived, everyone was incredibly kind, compassionate, and caring—not only with her but with me as well. They took the time to explain everything and made us both feel comfortable during a very stressful situation.

What truly stood out was that they called the next day to check on how Grace did overnight. That level of compassion and dedication means so much. I felt genuinely supported throughout the entire experience.

I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a veterinary team that truly cares about their patients and their families. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of Grace!
Dayani, excellent service, 100% recommended

I had a great experience with my dog Taylor. Everything was very well explained by the technician and Vianne was always there to cuddle Taylor and make him feel comfortable with the new environment. The prices for each vaccines and the liquid to clean the ears were explained to me before doing them, which to me was important because they made sure I knew what I was paying before proceeding. The doctor was caring. I will come back!

If you are rich then you can afford this clinic.  My cat had a rash and Dr. Ramirez wanted to run all kind of tests totally to $594.00. I almost fell off the chair.  I ended up just buying the medicine and getting the hell out of there.  I was under the impression that they were part of the ANIMAL WELFARE SOCIETY located on SW 27 AVE  which is non profit with much reasonable prices 🤔.

We brought in a stray kitten for deworming, and everyone was incredibly helpful. Rosie at the front desk was especially sweet and welcoming. The entire staff was kind, caring, and made sure our kitten received great care. Thank you all for your compassion and excellent service!
